blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Lee Jae Myung said Tuesday that he and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi had agreed to deepen cooperation and expand strategic communication amid a “grave” international situation. The two leaders met on the sidelines of the Asean-related meetings in Manila, the Philippines. “The international situation surrounding our two countries remains grave. The more challenging the times, the more South Korea and Japan must deepen their cooperation and broaden strategic communication,” Lee wrote in a post on X following the summit. “The prime minister and I shared this understanding at today’s summit and agreed to develop bilateral relations […]...
